title: The input of a language model is far poorer than a body’s

statements.text: A language model receives only abstract binary-coded text, which makes no rich contact with the world. Its input differs more from human sensory input than human input differs from a bat’s, and adding data streams alone would not yield consciousness, since an Umwelt presupposes an agent.

sources.quote: the information stream provided to LLMs is more different from the one presented to humans than ours is from bats
consciousness does not arise merely from data, and hence that simply adding massive data streams to future AI systems will not lead to consciousness
